note: Committed files generated from sources. The landing queue (docs/cloud/land-queue.md) runs `regenerate` before the checks when a change touches one of `sources` (holding one of `markers`, when given) and folds the rewritten files into the change; a rebase conflict only in these files takes the target's copy and writes it again. Commands run at the top of the repository with CARGO_TARGET_DIR set to a build slot.
